verses: When the sun is in the east, That lovely girl I see. In my chamber she appears; There fronting me is she. She treads upon my footsteps, And quickly comes to me.
When the moon is in the east, That lovely girl I see. 'Twixt door and screen she passes; 'Twixt screen and door is she. She treads upon my footsteps, And hastes away from me.
